outcome: Copy readable Experiments into an independent owned workspace
owner_impact: A Professor viewing a student's read-only Experiment can copy an exact saved revision into My Experiments. The new copy is private, independently editable and organisable, while the student's source remains unchanged. The registry preserves which source Experiment and revision the copy came from.
remaining_action: No owner action is required. Next development task in the approved epic: #289 — explicit read-only Experiment sharing.
technical_evidence: copy_experiment_to_workspace atomically copies the saved canonical Experiment payload and records immutable source provenance.
The public browser RPC is SECURITY INVOKER; privileged copy logic is confined to the non-exposed private schema with explicit caller/readability/revision checks.
The copy action uses the saved source revision, not unsaved local professor-side edits; the copied Experiment then has its own identity and revision lifecycle.
